why am i so tired all the time. why do i wake up at 3am. is it normal to forget words mid sentence. my thyroid test is normal but.
People type that last one so often the search box finishes it for them. Those are not five separate problems — most of the time they are one picture, and one number was never going to explain a whole year of how you have felt.

media:group.media:title: Menopause and the grandmother whales
media:group.media:description:
Menopause and the grandmother whales
In the whole animal kingdom, menopause is incredibly rare. Humans share it with just five species of toothed whale. Scientists think it evolved so older females could live longer and lead. Orca grandmothers guide their pods. Menopause isn't an ending. It's a role. Follow @healwithshivanih for midlife health, minus the fear.

entry.title: The Hormone Therapy Warning Is Gone. Now What for Perimenopause?

media:group.media:title: The Hormone Therapy Warning Is Gone. Now What for Perimenopause?
media:group.media:description:
For more than 20 years a black box warning kept women and their doctors away from menopause hormone therapy (HRT). In November 2025 the US FDA began taking most of it off the label.
In this video: where the fear came from (the 2002 Women's Health Initiative study), what the headlines left out, what actually changed in 2025 and 2026 and what did not, how to walk into your appointment with a score and five questions, and what is in your own hands whether you take hormone therapy or not: food, sleep, strength training and stress.
Whether hormone therapy is right for you is a decision for you and your doctor.
📘 The guide: a symptom score tracker and the five questions, with room for the answers: https://grow.theochretree.com/hrt-guide.html?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=hrt-perimenopause
